children: OTTAWA, Aug 28 (Reuters) - Canada's economy grew by 3.3% on an annualized basis in the second quarter, just short of analysts' expectations, on higher exports, household spending and business capital investment, Statistics Canada data showed on Friday.    June GDP rose 0.3% compared to May, above analysts' expectations, while July GDP was likely unchanged, StatsCan said in a flash estimate.    Following are seasonally adjusted figures for gross domestic product, in percent. With the exception of the price index data, they are adjusted for inflation.

Q2     Q1     Q4  Annualized change              +3.3   +0.3   -1.0  Change from previous quarter   +0.8   +0.1   -0.2   Quarterly change in GDP           implicit price index          +2.5   +1.2   +1.0

NOTE: The median forecast of analysts in a Reuters poll was for 3.4% annualized increase in the second quarter and for June GDP to be up 0.2%.  (Reporting by Dale Smith; editing by Promit Mukherjee) ((promit.mukherjee@tr.com))
